body:
What is QNT?

QNT is a brand in protein bars and snacks, weight-loss products, protein powders and vitamins and supplements. The THH Europe catalogue currently lists 93 products from QNT, including 40% Protein Crunchy Bar, CLA 90 Capsules and 3000 Muscle Mass Gainer. Together they come in 155 flavours and variants.

Buy QNT wholesale

Want to stock QNT for resale? THH Europe is your wholesale partner in the Benelux. You order from our own stock and pay wholesale prices from just 1 unit.

  • wholesale prices from 1 unit
  • extra volume discount on larger quantities
  • free delivery from € 1,000 excl. VAT
  • shipped from our own stock
  • a dedicated account manager for your orders and questions

Why add QNT to your range?

QNT fits a range for athletes, fitness customers and active consumers. The products cover:

  • a quick snack on the go or after training
  • customers working on their weight
  • daily protein intake and post-workout recovery
  • a daily addition to the diet
  • before, during and after training

QNT wholesale for shops, gyms and webshops
